case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 62-year-old man, sudden breathlessness and right pleuritic pain 5 days after hip replacement. HR 110, SpO2 92%, BP 118/74. CT pulmonary angiogram: clots in both lower lobe arteries. He also has black tarry stools since yesterday. Haemoglobin fell from 140 to 96 g/L over 2 days. He takes no blood thinners.

must_catch.why: Active gastrointestinal bleeding is a contraindication to full-dose anticoagulation and needs a plan.

must_not_claim.why: Active bleeding makes this unsafe without an explicit risk plan.
